costume.name: Clockwork Aviator
costume.description: Brass goggles and a shearling flight jacket bring a warm, adventurous feel to everyday utility trousers.
costume.alt: Brown leather flight cap with brass goggles, caramel shearling jacket, cream shirt, brown utility trousers, and dark boots

pieces.name: Brown flight cap
queries: brown aviator flight cap ear flaps chin strap
pieces.styleNotes: Brown leather-look flight helmet with ear coverage and a chin strap. Goggles are a separate purchase. The premium handmade cap has the closest sculpted side details. Atom Leather does not publish head measurements or a production duration; confirm fit and timing with the maker.

matches.reason: Dark brown sheepskin flying helmet with cream padded edge, straps and military oxygen-mask hooks. Selected M is $130; XS, S, L and XL have different prices and are excluded here. Goggles not included. Merchant lists standard handling of 2–4 business days; custom work takes longer.

Distressed brown faux leather, 75% polyester/25% cotton, adjustable buckled chin strap. Merchant explicitly excludes the goggles shown in its photo. Public merchant product API confirms four in stock and no backorder at $27.

Mahogany-brown real leather with stitched panels, circular brass-mesh side accents and brass-tone buckle. Cap only; goggles not included. Made to order in Bucharest, with worldwide tracked shipping. Production duration and head measurements are not published; confirm fit and timing with the maker. Purchasable feed is not evidence of ready stock.

pieces.name: Brass-colored goggles
queries: brass brown steampunk goggles adjustable strap
pieces.styleNotes: Round brass or gold-tone rims with a brown body and adjustable strap. Wear over the cap; the products differ in lens tint and ornament.

matches.reason: One pair of brass-colored goggles with wide adjustable elastic and dark green glass lenses. Dark green is the standard lens, not clear. Current merchant feed confirms available at $16.99. No cap included.

Brown plastic body, gold rims, clear lenses and brown elastic strap. Less antiqued than the image. Merchant API confirms 39 in stock, not on backorder, at $9. Goggles only; flight cap sold separately.

Handmade goggles with embossed faux leather, brass-colored rims, dark lenses and adjustable nylon band. Lenses unscrew for cleaning. More floral embossing than the image. Live product structured data lists USD $49.95 and InStock. Cap not included; no dispatch duration is stated.

pieces.name: Brown shearling flight jacket
queries: brown shearling B3 aviator flight jacket
pieces.styleNotes: Brown flight jacket with a large cream or golden shearling collar. Faux leather is acceptable. Exact pocket, trim and brown shades differ. Blacktop Gear jacket requires 2–3 weeks production; it is not a ready-stock choice. The budget jacket lacks the image’s cream cuff and hem trim.

matches.reason: Tobacco-brown faux leather and beige faux shearling lining/collar; asymmetric front zip and silver hardware. No exposed cream hem/cuff trim like the image. Live US page inventory confirms 12 M and 11 L, neither preorder. Other sizes are sold out. Sale price $85.40; jacket only.

Brown leather B3-style bomber with cream shearling collar, cuffs and hem, throat strap and an attached waist belt. Darker than caramel. Made to order: stated production about 2–3 weeks before shipping; free USA delivery. $180 applies to standard S–5XL; custom sizing costs extra. Purchasable, but ready stock is not verified.

Heavyweight brown sheepskin with golden shearling, leather-welted seams and buckled collar/waist straps. Golden fleece is warmer than the image’s cream. Made in USA. Brn / Golden sizes 34–46 are $1,690; size 32 is sold out, 48+ cost more. Selected-page inventory shows one unit per included size with deny-oversell policy. Jacket only.

pieces.name: Cream collared shirt
queries: mens cream ivory collared cotton shirt
pieces.styleNotes: A light cream or ivory shirt under the open flight jacket. A simple point collar and visible button front preserve the look.

matches.reason: Ivory 100% cotton long-sleeve shirt, point collar, gathered yokes and a broad two-row button placket. Fuller period cut and paired buttons differ from the simple image shirt. Current feed confirms S, L, XL, 2X and 3X at $69.95; M and 4X unavailable. Shirt only, trousers in photo are excluded.

Cream/off-white 100% cotton shirt with point collar and full button front. Short sleeves differ from the image, but sit under the jacket. Merchant variant endpoint /remote/v1/product-attributes/2106 confirms S (attribute 4755) and M (4758) in stock at $18.95; larger available sizes cost $19.95 and are excluded. Shirt only.

Cream 100% cotton long-sleeve button-down with one chest pocket, made in USA. Shorter untucked-length cut differs from the long image shirt. Only S and XL are currently available at $225; XS, M and L are sold out. Product-only styling items are not included.

pieces.name: Brown utility trousers
pieces.styleNotes: Brown cargo trousers with large thigh pockets and enough room to tuck into boots. No option includes the image’s decorative thigh strap or waist belt.

matches.reason: Vintage Brown, 97% cotton/3% spandex cargo trousers with waist adjusters and visible modern pocket branding. S–2XL available at $74.99; 3XL sold out. Live page variant stock templates show S=2, M=4, L=2, XL=5, 2XL=4. The page’s backorder paragraph is hidden, not active for these variants. US orders ship from the USA; no belt included.

Work Brown cotton/polyester twill BDU cargo trousers with reinforced knees/seat, adjustable waist tabs, button fly and drawstring leg openings. Warmer golden brown than the image. S–XL cost $45.99; 2XL and 3XL cost more and are excluded. Merchant product feed and structured offers confirm stock. No belt or thigh strap included.

Brown non-stretch 100% cotton military-inspired cargo pants, extra lower-leg pocket, concealed snap and zip fly. Straight hems differ from the image’s elastic cuffs; tuck into boots. Waist labels 28–38 in stock at $195; 40 sold out. Merchant says processing within 24–48 hours; no belt or thigh strap included.

pieces.name: Dark brown lace-up boots
queries: mens dark brown lace up leather boots
pieces.styleNotes: Dark brown lace-up boots ground the aviator look. These practical ankle boots are shorter than the image’s tall buckled boots. All three boot options have ankle-height shafts, below the image’s tall calf shaft.

matches.reason: Brown leather cap-toe ankle boot with waxed cotton laces, glove leather lining and studded rubber sole. Shorter than the image and has no upper buckles. Standard-width sizes 6–16 listed here are all available at $199 in current feed. US order processing typically 1–3 business days; delivery timing is separate.

Brown CH style 85088-215, leather/man-made mixed upper and modern lug wedge sole. Live merchant page lists $89.95. Read-only width selection confirmed M (D medium) and every listed size explicitly In Stock; response saved in nunn-medium-width.xml. Shorter and more modern than the image, with no calf buckles. Stated usual dispatch 2–3 business days.

Crimson Chromexcel dark reddish-brown leather plain-toe lace-up ankle boot with antique-brass eyelets/hooks and rubber sole. Lower shaft and no calf buckles. D Standard sizes 6–13 listed here are available at $435. Higher price does not make it a closer costume match.
